base: r60 Contact-force QP MPC, full joint inverse-dynamics WBC and PD60/5

online.nominal: Original homogeneous-support force QP with identical currently latched contact request and committed swings
online.trial: One material relinearization, same QP state cost, original force regularization and difference cost, force cone, active contacts, plant and WBC bounds
online.integration: Split at nominal stage boundaries and online predicted contact switches. Piecewise node force, event footprint and common sole/unique world cell ownership. Equal FP64 substeps of each segment with maximum 0.0002 s
online.geometry: Time-averaged force-driven loaded-sole height and material support availability fraction per stage. Current first force point remains measured
online.choice: Propagate each candidate through its own private constitutive response. Re-evaluate both with one common material+centroidal evaluator. Numerical ties within 1e-12 relative objective retain nominal. If only nominal material-feasible, select it and record trial rejection. If no material-feasible nominal and trial generation unavailable, fail explicitly
online.execution: Selected original or relinearized QP state/force replaces last_plan before original WBC; every first mapped input recorded. WBC uses its unchanged present material normal law
online.timing: P1 base always original nominal handover. The actual and predicted scheduler use the one latched R request if provided
online.private_reset: Once at publication, reset all six e/q/stress components only for ever-loaded future queried keys outside all current measured/loaded sole geometries and their sharing closure; keep actor, online observer and actual WBC untouched
online.unobserved_geometry: Allowed future keys are virgin, loaded columns fixed once per candidate; inactive target keys recover throughout the candidate

physical_backend.scope: Disjoint footprint ownership groups run independently; byte-identical within-sole states reuse the exact constitutive evaluation. A shared group is never split; force summation retains input order.
physical_backend.qualification: 19 M0 saved states, every cell state, depth, objective, corrected force and winner bitwise equal to serial. 28.6002 s serial and 5.7396 s parallel combined; original QP stays single worker.

saved_event_selection: All four possible legs x first loading, first release following at least .05 s loaded, first cross-foot reactivation with known prior release, in the first outbound traversals of both original r60 E30. Deduplicate by preceding saved MPC before target minus .04 s. Shared body/force scores, held-out next measured boundary and independent WBC reconstruction.
qualification: New identity requires original E30 and E60 per actor case. Mechanism episodes scored separately.
